paper_title: Collapse Operation Increases Expressive Power of Deterministic Higher Order Pushdown Automata
statement: The following question remains open: is there a language recognized by a collapsible deterministic higher order pushdown automaton which is not recognized by any deterministic higher order pushdown automaton without collapse of any level? It is possible that the language U from Theorem 1 has this property.
